exposure: experimental group (sufentanil citrate, palonosetron hydrochloride, and esketamine)
use of esketamine during cesarean section
control group (sufentanil citrate and palonosetron hydrochloride)
cohort: 240 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
finding: Esketamine use during cesarean section was associated with improved pain control and a lower incidence of postpartum depression.
